problem.belowFloor: A bid below the round's floor is refused.
problem.tooSmall: A bid must be worth at least the minimum at the floor price.
problem.belowBond: The deposit must be at least the bond.
problem.belowEscrow: The deposit must cover what the bid escrows: its price times its quantity.

phase.salt: Sign the secret of your bid in your wallet…

page.title: Auction · the Monday reopening
page.intro: Bid on the Stock Tokens of accounts that fell short over the weekend, in the auction that settles at the regular open on {chain}.
page.connect: Connect a wallet to bid. The auction's stage and every round below are read from the chain without one.
page.wrongNetwork: Your wallet is on another network. Tapehouse runs on {chain}.
page.absent: The reopening auction is not deployed on this chain yet.
page.done: Done. Every figure is read again from the chain.

stage.title: Where the auction stands
stage.idle: No round is open. A round opens when a weekend or holiday closure is about to end.
stage.committing: Bids are being committed. The reveal begins on {reveal} UTC, half an hour before the regular open on {open} UTC.
stage.revealing: Bids are being revealed, until the regular open on {open} UTC. A commitment not revealed by then forfeits part of its deposit.
stage.clearing: The round awaits its clearing price, which anyone may submit until {closes} UTC. The regular open was on {open} UTC.
stage.cleared: The round cleared. The regular open was on {open} UTC; winning bidders may claim their tokens.
stage.lapsed: The clearing window closed without a price. The regular open was on {open} UTC; every bidder may claim its whole escrow back.

sealed.body: You commit to a hidden bid with a deposit. Nobody sees its price or size until the half hour before the regular open, when you reveal it.

uniform.body: The round has a single clearing price: the highest price at which the bids at or above it take the whole supply. Every winning bid pays that price, whatever it offered.

floor.body: No bid may be below the floor, 10% under the low edge of the band sealed before the reopen.

backstop.body: What the bids do not take, the gap backstop buys at the clearing price, never above the band's low edge and within its exposure limit.

reveal.body: A commitment you do not reveal before the regular open forfeits part of its deposit, at least the bond.

round.title: The round
round.caption: Each asset's reopening round: its floor, its lots and supply, what is committed and revealed, and the clearing price
round.resultCaption: For each cleared round: the price, what the bids bought, what they paid and what the backstop took

bids.title: Revealed bids
bids.none: No bid has been revealed yet.
bids.caption: The revealed bids of {asset}, highest price first

bid.title: Place a bid
bid.priceLabel: Highest price you will pay, in USD per token
bid.floorUnset: The round has no price to take a floor from yet, so your price cannot be checked against it.
bid.floorProjected: The round has not opened: its floor is projected from the band it will take it from, and the first commitment fixes it.
bid.escrow: Once revealed, this bid escrows {escrow} USDG: its price times its quantity.
bid.hides: A deposit above the escrow hides the size of your bid; what is not escrowed comes back when you reveal.
bid.balance: You hold {amount} USDG; the bond is {bond} USDG.
bid.flow: Your wallet first signs a free message that derives the secret of your bid, may ask you to approve USDG, then commits.
bid.closed: Bids are committed only before the reveal begins.
bid.saved: The secret of each bid is derived from your wallet; this browser keeps the rest of it to reveal it.

mine.title: Your bids
mine.none: You have no bids in the auction.
mine.caption: Your bids by round: what each one offers, where it stands and what it can do next
mine.unsaved: Revealed from another browser; it can still be claimed here.
mine.forfeitNote: A commitment not revealed before the regular open forfeits part of its deposit, at least the bond; the rest comes back.
mine.waitReveal: Reveal opens half an hour before the regular open.
mine.waitClear: Claim opens once the round is cleared.

clear.title: Clear the round
clear.body: Anyone may clear a round: it sells each lot to the bids at the clearing price and the backstop buys the rest. The contract checks the price against the revealed bids.
clear.none: No price clears {asset}: it has no supply for its bids.
